description: 32-case synthetic portfolio benchmark covering critical incidents, ambiguous signals, benign lookalikes, identity, endpoint, network, cloud, email, and data-loss alerts. Labels are illustrative and require practitioner adjudication; not production ground truth.

event.title: Ransomware encryption of files
event.description: Rapid mass file rename and encryption of files detected across a server.

event.title: Possible data exfiltration
event.description: Large outbound transfer and possible data theft from a sensitive asset.

event.title: Password spray detected
event.description: Multiple failed login attempts consistent with password spray against admin account.

event.title: Malware command and control beacon
event.description: Known malicious process shows command and control C2 beacon activity.

event.title: Suspicious login
event.description: Suspicious login detected; validate impossible travel and MFA events.

event.title: Informational policy notice
event.description: Routine policy reminder with no suspicious activity reported.

event.title: Routine low severity notice
event.description: Scheduled inventory scan completed successfully.

event.title: Unusual admin privileges
event.description: Admin privileges observed on a new account; review whether this change was approved.

event.title: MFA fatigue attempts
event.description: Repeated MFA push prompts reported by a user; no successful login confirmed.

event.title: Confirmed ransomware behavior
event.description: Endpoint telemetry reports mass encryption and ransom note creation on a production host.

event.title: VPN login from new region
event.description: Successful VPN login from a new region; approved travel and device posture are unknown.

event.title: Successful patch installation
event.description: Endpoint reports routine monthly patch installation completed without errors.

event.title: Repeated outbound DNS to suspicious domain
event.description: Endpoint makes repeated DNS requests to a newly observed suspicious domain; payload evidence is unavailable.

event.title: New service account created
event.description: A new service account was created; ticket and owner validation are missing.

event.title: Sensitive database export and transfer
event.description: Audit logs show export of sensitive customer records followed by outbound transfer to an unapproved destination.

event.title: Password expiry reminder
event.description: Routine password expiry notification sent; no authentication anomalies are reported.

event.title: Privileged login after repeated failures
event.description: Privileged account login succeeded after many failed attempts; source and MFA context need validation.

event.title: Potential unwanted application detected
event.description: Endpoint tool flagged a potentially unwanted application; execution and impact are not yet established.

event.title: Approved vulnerability scan
event.description: Scheduled vulnerability scanner contacted registered internal hosts during its approved window.

event.title: Public storage access changed
event.description: Cloud storage policy changed to allow public access; data sensitivity and approval status are unknown.

event.title: Suspicious attachment quarantined
event.description: Email gateway quarantined a suspicious attachment before delivery; user execution is not reported.

event.title: Multiple hosts show ransomware indicators
event.description: Several endpoints report rapid file modifications and ransom-note indicators within a short interval.

event.title: Routine token refresh
event.description: Expected application token refresh completed from a known workload identity.

event.title: Unusual API key use
event.description: Cloud API key was used from a new network and performed privileged enumeration; owner confirmation is pending.

event.title: Unsigned script blocked
event.description: Endpoint protection blocked an unsigned script; no successful execution was observed.

event.title: Possible lateral movement
event.description: Multiple internal hosts show unusual remote service connections from one workstation; authentication evidence is incomplete.

event.title: Inventory agent heartbeat
event.description: Managed inventory agent sent its normal scheduled heartbeat with no anomalies.

event.title: Privileged account takeover indicators
event.description: Privileged account MFA was reset unexpectedly and followed by a successful login from an unknown device.

event.title: Reported phishing message
event.description: User reported a suspicious email; no link click or credential submission has been confirmed.

event.title: Large upload to personal cloud service
event.description: Endpoint telemetry shows a large upload to a personal cloud service from a sensitive workstation; authorization is unknown.

event.title: Unexpected group membership
event.description: A user was added to a privileged group; change request and approval details are not attached.

event.title: Disk health warning
event.description: Endpoint reports a disk health warning without suspicious process or network activity.
